summary: Axon filed an 8-K disclosing an incremental minority investment of roughly $1.2 billion in Skydio, lifting its ownership from about 15% (as of September 30, 2026) to approximately 37% on a fully diluted basis. Consideration is expected to be ~60% cash (~$720 million) and the remainder in Axon common stock, with final mix subject to Series G settlement. The initial closing occurred November 5, 2026: 25,000,000 non-voting Series G preferred shares at $10.19617/share, ~$254.9 million, half cash and half Axon stock. Remaining tranches expected across Q4 2026 and Q1 2027. Watch equity issuance, lock-up overhang and closing conditions.
